Adjustable rack

NEMA17 · 40 mm travel · axial NEMA17 output plate

One rigid carrier supports both lower bearings. Four M3 screws pull it upward into the rack; loosen evenly before withdrawing the rack. Heat-set inserts carry the adjustment threads.

Six integral split PETG axles retain the guide bearings. Bearing seats touch the inner races only. Pin strain, load capacity and PETG creep require a physical test.
